subsystems.name: Warp shell (the metric)
subsystems.role: a thin wall of strongly curved spacetime, contracted ahead of the craft and expanded behind it, so the craft rides a moving pocket of flat space.

subsystems.name: Exotic stress-energy source
subsystems.role: supplies the negative energy density the shell geometry demands.

subsystems.name: Bubble generator
subsystems.role: a structure surrounding the craft that imposes the required energy-density pattern.

subsystems.name: Craft and habitat
subsystems.role: sits in the interior region, where spacetime is nearly flat so tidal forces stay tolerable.

subsystems.name: Navigation and control
subsystems.role: shapes and steers the bubble, and eventually collapses it to stop.

subsystems.name: Power and heat rejection
subsystems.role: energises the shell and dumps the waste heat of an extreme energy process.

buildSteps.title: Choose the geometry
buildSteps.detail: Specify the desired bubble shape and solve the Einstein field equations for the spacetime that realises it — the step Miguel Alcubierre set out in 1994.

buildSteps.title: Compute the required stress-energy
buildSteps.detail: Work out what distribution of energy and momentum that spacetime needs. The result is the problem: the wall must carry large negative energy density, with more of it the thinner and faster the bubble.

buildSteps.title: Obtain negative energy density at scale
buildSteps.detail: Negative energy density is real but tiny — the Casimir effect between close plates and squeezed states of light both show it. The unsolved task is producing it in macroscopic amounts over a shell metres or kilometres across.

buildSteps.title: Build the emitter shell
buildSteps.detail: Construct a structure enclosing the craft that can impose the required vacuum state and hold it stable against quantum-inequality limits, which normally forbid sustained negative energy.

buildSteps.title: Assemble the craft
buildSteps.detail: Fit the crew module and its life support inside the shell, in the region where spacetime is nearly flat and internal physics behaves normally.

buildSteps.title: Initiate and hold the bubble
buildSteps.detail: Bring the shell to its operating state. Curvature at the wall would reach extreme values, so this step depends on physics we do not yet have — including whether the wall survives its own quantum back-reaction.

buildSteps.title: Steer
buildSteps.detail: Modify the bubble's symmetry to shift the contracted region, so the pocket moves. One obstacle is causal: the craft cannot send signals to the front of its own bubble, so the crew cannot steer it by conventional means.

buildSteps.title: Arrive and stop
buildSteps.detail: Collapse the shell, returning spacetime to its normal state, and dissipate the released energy safely.

prerequisites.why: Alcubierre's 1994 solution shows that a contracting/expanding bubble is mathematically allowed by the field equations, which is why this is physics speculation rather than fantasy.
the required energy condition does not occur in nature at anything close to the needed magnitude.
the geometry involves curvature on scales where general relativity and quantum mechanics both matter, and only a combined theory can say whether such a spacetime can exist and stay stable.

prerequisites.tech: An energy supply of astronomical scale
prerequisites.why: early estimates put the requirement near the mass-energy of the universe; later refinements cut it by many orders of magnitude but still leave it far beyond any conceivable power source.

pathway.milestone: refining warp metrics to minimise the required negative energy, and testing them against quantum-inequality bounds
pathway.unlocks: a clearer answer on whether a warp bubble is physically permitted at all.

pathway.milestone: precision laboratory study of negative energy densities — Casimir cavities, squeezed light — and how far they can be scaled
pathway.unlocks: an experimental handle on exotic energy, and hard limits on it.

pathway.milestone: a quantum theory of gravity that predicts the stability and back-reaction of warp spacetimes
pathway.unlocks: a definitive verdict, positive or negative, on buildability.

pathway.milestone: if permitted, engineering of negative-energy densities many orders of magnitude beyond laboratory scale
pathway.unlocks: a microscopic test bubble, the first hardware demonstration.

pathway.milestone: a crewed warp shell travelling at an effective speed above that of light
pathway.unlocks: interstellar travel within a human lifetime.
